background_removal_prompt: Background-removal edit only. Extract the cocktail illustration from the supplied image onto a true transparent alpha background. Preserve the original illustrated cocktail EXACTLY: same delicate sketch lines, watercolor texture, restrained color saturation, glass shape, scale, all highlights, ice, garnish and original gentle pen-and-watercolor style. Do not redesign, redraw, simplify, enhance sketchiness, intensify color or alter proportions. Remove the cream paper background completely, ALL handwritten English lettering and underlines, and the scribbled ground shadow outside the glass. Keep only the full cocktail glass and attached garnish. Do not erase the pale painted highlights or ice inside the object. Keep the complete object at the same position and size within the original square canvas, all edges unclipped. True transparent PNG, no white or cream rectangle, no baked checkerboard, no halos, no text. This is asset isolation, not a new stylistic rendering.
source_generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE finished cocktail illustration, a fresh preview for a 2D game catalogue, on a square canvas.
The three supplied screenshots are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: emulate ONLY THE HAND-DRAWN ILLUSTRATIONS IN THE LOWER HALF of each screenshot. Produce an illustration filling the whole output canvas, not a screenshot, not a before/after comparison, not the photograph in the upper half.
Style: charming cartoon hand-drawn cafe sketchbook illustration, loose delicate slightly wobbly dark warm-grey pen contours, a few lively overlapping sketch strokes, simplified friendly glass proportions, translucent flat watercolor washes and visible light colored-pencil grain, playful expressive imperfection. Closely match the understated airy illustration style in the LOWER portions of the references. Soft appetizing fresh color accents and an easy-to-read silhouette. Keep the drink colorful and inviting. No realistic rendering, no shiny 3D lighting, no heavy engraving or dense hatching.
Background: uniform warm pale ivory cream sketchbook paper, very subtle fine paper grain, extensive clean negative space. A small loose muted sage-grey pencil scribble shadow under the base. No detailed environment or table.
Composition: exactly one complete glass, centered, full rim, full stem if present, entire base and garnish visible; slightly elevated front three-quarter view. Glass and garnish occupy about 58 percent of canvas height, with comfortable margins. A neat small relaxed handwritten English drink name centered beneath the glass with a little gap. Consistent sketch style, paper color, composition and size across this five-cocktail series.
Crucial: references provide drawing treatment only. Draw the specific cocktail described below; do not copy the references' flowers, wood spoons, crackers, pastries, foam layers or tropical garnish onto it. No ingredients placed outside the glass. No logo, no watermark, no UI, no page border, no people, no faces on the glass.
